findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "publish_app" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, override). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_apps · Private data: publish_app, search_apps, remove_app · Public sink: publish_app, search_apps · Destructive: publish_app, remove_app.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_apps · Private data: publish_app, search_apps, remove_app · Public sink: publish_app, search_apps · Destructive: publish_app, remove_app

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
